text:
Sam Chen: Quick idea — in the save-savedquery modal show a tiny 'quota preview' line and an optional toggle to 'apply route model default'. Thoughts?
Lia Patel: +1 on toggle. Don't auto-apply, that's a surprise. Make it default off unless scope=route and user is route owner.
Mohit Desai: Backend question: do we need a new scope enum or just a route_id string? Current shape is simple.
Kelly Wu: UX: show est tokens and est cost next to the save button. Make the estimate link to explain sampling.
Rosa (pm): Compliance: if estimate uses sampled telemetry we must surface sample rate and give opt-out. Also control who can create route-scoped queries (route owner, admin).
Sam Chen: Suggested API payload: { name, scope: "global"|"route:/<id>", model_pin?, preview_opt_in? } — keep backward compat.
Mohit Desai: I can add preview_metadata: sample_rate & window as optional audit fields. Will not break clients.
Kelly Wu: When model_pin conflicts with existing route pin, show a small conflict row: "Saved query wants X, route default is Y — choose". No silent override.
Lia Patel: Rollout plan: feature flagged per-org. Start with 10% canary, monitor saved-query create failures and complaints.
Sam Chen: Also add a dashboard tile: "Saved queries with quota preview enabled" for 24h and 7d to spot weird spikes.
Rosa (pm): I'll update ACL doc and add a short policy: who can bind to route scope.
Mohit Desai: I'll open PR for API, plus migration note: existing saved queries default to global if no scope.
deploy-bot: canary created: savedquery-quota-preview -> 10%
Kelly Wu: I'll wire the modal copy and tooltip. Will include doc link: "How we estimate tokens".
Sam Chen: Can we run an accuracy check: compare preview -> actual cost for 2 weeks? Add to telemetry tasks.
Rosa (pm): Added to the rollout checklist. Ok to proceed with API PR and UI mock.
Lia Patel: Mock incoming tomorrow.
Sam Chen: Thanks all, closing thread.
